signals.usability_note: Clear daytime view of a residential frontage showing a two-story house with a front lawn, though a large tree and evergreens partially obscure the house and roof.

professional_landscaping.evidence: Mulched beds with shrubs and a small landscape light are tidy, but this is consistent with homeowner upkeep and no crew or equipment is visible.

signals.notes: Well-kept lawn and mulched beds in front of a beige-sided two-story home; a silver car sits in the neighboring driveway on the left and a vehicle is partly visible on the right, and the roof is only partially visible through the trees.
